people.name: Ahikam
people.line: Son of Shaphan, protected Jeremiah from death

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Chaldea
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian empire; known for astrology and wisdom

people.name: Gedaliah
people.line: Appointed governor of Judah by Babylonians; assassinated by Ishmael.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Assassinated Gedaliah the governor; led captives to Ammon.

translations.web: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had killed Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.
translations.bsb: to escape the Chaldeans. For they were afraid of the Chaldeans because Ishmael son of Nethaniah had struck down Gedaliah son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon had appointed over the land.
translations.kjv: Because of the Chaldeans: for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor in the land.
translations.asv: because of the Chaldeans; for they were afraid of them, because Ishmael the son of Nethaniah had slain Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, whom the king of Babylon made governor over the land.
